info.name: Start a sample asynchronous job without authentication

items.docs: Public, no-auth demo of the asynchronous-job pattern. Starts a synthetic job and returns `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header (and `data.status_url`) pointing at the job-status resource. Poll `GET /demo/jobs/{id}` until the status is terminal. No real work runs; the status is a fixed sample.

info.name: Poll a sample asynchronous job without authentication

items.docs: Public, no-auth demo. Returns the status of a synthetic job started by `POST /demo/jobs` — the poll half of the async-job pattern. No real work runs; the status is a fixed sample.

Public, no-auth demo. Returns synthetic email objects shaped exactly like the authenticated `GET /emails` response (same `EmailSummary` schema), so an arriving agent can read the data model before obtaining credentials. No real tenant data is exposed; every object is a fixed sample. Rate-limited per IP.

info.name: Get one sample email without authentication

params.name: id
params.description: Any value; the demo returns a fixed sample.

items.docs: Public, no-auth demo. Returns a single synthetic email shaped exactly like the authenticated `GET /emails/{id}` response (`EmailDetail` schema). No real tenant data is exposed. Rate-limited per IP.
